name: AutomationDirect C0-10DD1E-D controller module
summary: C0-10DD1E-D controller module arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: C0-10DD1E-D is the drawing identifier for controller module in AutomationDirect's CLICK PLCs collection. A controller module runs a control program and exchanges information with its connected inputs, outputs and communications. The physical layout must still account for its exact mounting and connector positions.

For example, in a pump station where one controller coordinates the selected I/O, use the C0-10DD1E-D reference to coordinate programming and communications plugs, I/O assembly and service removal. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/CLICK/C0-10DD1E-D.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep programming and communications plugs, I/O assembly and service removal visible in the layout.
